scientific_integrity: The 119 reduced posets were exhaustively classified with two equivalent implementations of a mathematically proved rank-three invariant. The infinite reduction uses the standard linear-chain three-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé cutoff; finite boundary samples are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Pure strict-order first-order language; one to three nonempty finite chain components; rank exactly three. No higher-rank or unbounded-component classification is asserted; published-coverage search is not exhaustive.
title: Exactly 102 rank-three theories of finite direct sums of at most three chains
